name: effects_weaker_slow_waits
description: Two slows on one creep (design 3.2): the strongest with time left applies, each for its own time. A Lamplighter's Frost Spire (45% for 2 s) and a Lookout's Pinning Ballista (50% for 1 s) on one Thornback: while the 50% holds, the Frost's hits wait underneath and take hold the tick it lapses, so the creep never walks unslowed while either slow has time left, and a Pinning hit slows 50% for its one second, not for what was left of the Frost's. The same on the Bristlesow, where control resistance makes them 31.5% and 35%. The creep walks at 1000 micrometres a tick, so how far it gets each tick says how much it was slowed. A checkpoint taken while a slow waits under another keeps it: the loaded simulation matches the running one field for field.
